bio: While her Dryad sisters sat back and watched their gardens grow, Thylsa couldn't stand idle. The Horde had invaded the Emerald Kingdom, it was no time to be picking flowers. Now, Thylsa grows on the frontline – luring Darkborn with intoxicating blooms, then ensnaring them in thickets of deadly briar. They make for wonderful compost.
